summary: BCB Bancorp Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a firm-commitment underwritten follow-on offering of 11,000,000 common shares at $7.75 per share, grossing $85.25 million, with Piper Sandler as sole underwriter. The price represents a discount to the September 11, 2026 last sale of $8.58. Underwriting discounts total $0.42625 per share ($4.69 million), leaving $80.56 million before expenses. The company granted a 30-day option for 1,650,000 additional shares. Closing is expected on or about September 18, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown rather than a special situation.
